method.hash: imagehash dhash hash_size=16 (256 bits) on the site image composited on white; art crop = x 8-92%, y 12-60% of the card
method.rule: the hash proposes which illustration (art cluster); the printing's variant label plus the reviewer's read decides stamped versus unstamped. Nothing about stamps is inferred from a hash.
method.whole_card_stamp_separation: over the lane's 28 jp/cn base printings (14 jp + 14 cn, the jp _r1 reprint excluded), the nearest design on whole-card dhash16 was a STAMPED design in 4 of 28 (OP10-028 jp and cn, EB04-006 jp, OP12-078 cn); stamped-minus-unstamped margin -4 to +5 bits. Cause: each site prints its own SAMPLE watermark and card text over the art.
method.art_crop_recolour_separation: OP17 cards (base vs sepia _p1 recolour, 6 cards): art-crop margin recolour-minus-base is 1 to 32 bits for cn base and 2 to 34 bits for jp base; at the low end the eye decides.
method.translated_in_art_text: class ruling (upper, roberto-internal 93504): text drawn inside the illustration and translated per language does not make a new design. Worked case OP12-098: jp base / jp _r1 / cn base are 53 / 47 / 67 bits whole-card and 41 / 33 / 49 bits art-crop from the en base design.
method.sheets: contact sheets of art crops, each read under a 150KB image cap
